title.en: O 1 BRUNEI DARUSSALAM FISHERY LIMITS ORDER

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-130-O-1-BRUNEI-DARUSSALAM-FISHERY-LIMITS-ORDER.pdf》（7 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Acts may be cited as the Brunei Darussalam Fishery Limits Order. Brunei Darussalam fishery limits.
The limits indicated in paragraph 2 are depicted on a large scale map Series: Misc. 1 Edition: 1 JUAB Sheet 3 which is deposited in the office of the Surveyor general.
